facts.fact: The article says the New Deal Technologique, the national digital transformation strategy, was 'lancé' (launched) in 2025 and integrated into the Vision Sénégal 2050; it names no adopting act or body.

On 1-2 July 2026 the digital ministry, with Smart Africa and GIZ support, convened administrations, private sector and universities to define data and AI use cases for a future national data-value Blueprint accompanying the implementation of the New Deal Technologique.
